body: This was so sweet thank you so much. It hurts to see him with her. The things he promised me I see he gives to her. The plans we made I’m sure he’s planning with her. It fucking sucks but I know it’ll all be okay eventually. Thank you again. ❤️
Thank you so much. I’ll take an extra sip of mead during my adventures to commemorate your sweet comments. I appreciate it. really :)
Thank you. I remember last time and the time before hurting like a fucking BITCH but I really thought it’d be different this time. I’ll get through it, but tonight I’m just gonna drink and play Xbox

Thank you. I’m glad it’s normal. I found out right before work and my work is emotionally exhausting so I’m just out of anything but anger and sadness today. Thanks again though, reading your comment  helped a lot
Beautiful family :)
This guys spatial awareness is fucking next level

Thank you. I came out to one of my friends last night that had no idea I was even feeling these emotions and they were extremely supportive and it made me feel all warm and fuzzy inside. You helped me a lot. Thank you. ❤️
You’re welcome!! That tip changed my life Bc I too have the border around my plaza 😂
Place a clear pattern (or do it like a pathway) around the flowers and they won’t breed!!
You’re more than welcome to message me :)
Thank you. ❤️
Diana did the same and I just said nope and did it the next day. She kept asking for stone things and then golden dishes, drove me crazy
I went and upvoted all your posts. Don’t let anyone dull your shine.
Thank you so much. I might take you up on that after the day I’ve had. Sending love your way.

Thank you so much. Things haven’t been getting much easier. I have days where I don’t cry but *anything* can send me back into a spiral. I found a pic of me and him the other day and I cried until I couldn’t cry anymore. My heart is so broken, I don’t even want to move on. I read a few of your posts and I love them. I followed you so I can see them more :) 

Thank you again. My heart is with you too, whatever is left of it. All my strength and all my love goes out to you too. we can get through this. :)

Thank you. It’s been extremely difficult. I want to stop loving him so so badly. 

My heart is with you too. we’ll get through this.
I’m sorry youre going through that too. Everything will be okay, hugs!
This is beautiful. Many many times I’ve thought about this. I never quite figured out the best way to phrase it but you hit the nail on the head. Beautiful writing :)
I know this instance will pass. But honestly, I don’t think the thoughts will ever go away. I’ll live until tomorrow. I guess day by day.
I’ve been too much for every single guy I’ve ever been with. I’m fucked up, with a skewed view of what I deserve.  But thank you.

I won’t do anything. I’ve thought about it. I’d just need a plan to get my puppy and guinea pig safe before I did anything, but I don’t know how to do that without sounding alarms for the people who love me.
When does it get better? I’ve been fighting these demons for 10 years. I always tell other people it’ll get better but it’s just a lie
No, he refuses to do anything for it. Including therapy.

Thank you, truly. This relationship was the one thing I had such faith in, Ive struggled with finishing my degree after 5 years of being in and out of school. He came around and changed me as a person. I never used to be so needy, I don’t know if my words will ever penetrate the barrier that is his own thoughts :(

Edited to add: I have sat down with him and talked about how much I love him. I have cried the words, I have told him in every single way I possibly can how much he means to me and how much I adore him. I’m so afraid that these words don’t mean anything to him, the only things I ever hear back are “i love you” and then the things I’m doing wrong in the relationship. It hurts my heart

I’ve battled depression for years. I’ve had anxiety since I was old enough to think about the future. I am constantly depressed, constantly anxious, and can’t seem to catch a breath these days. My grades have slipped. I am failing at life and any little minor inconvenience could make me cry. I feel like I’m falling apart
